tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Galle (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commissariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

Today was a very eventful day as I am juggling many different tasks and projects all while being a Stanford student. I am studying biology so often times need to work in the lab for long hours. Today, I measured tumor growth in mice that I injected with subcutaneous tumors. It was very fun and cool to see. I hope to do more work with them in the future.
